rationale: All 5 blocking findings from the initial review (CR-001 through CR-005) have been addressed in the follow-up commit 0bc141824. CR-003, CR-004, and CR-005 (rollup semantics ambiguities) were resolved by: filtering pending/failed-sync budget rows before summation, guarding against mixed budget_duration windows, and deduping member counts across linked projects via set-based accumulation rather than summation. Standards review now passes. No new findings introduced in the fixes.
